completion: Both columns must share the same projection; otherwise removeIntersection will throw an error. Ensure they match before calling the method: ```import { SimpleDB } from "@nshiab/simple-data-analysis"; const sdb = new SimpleDB(); const table = sdb.newTable(); await table.loadGeoData("./data.geojson"); // Verify projections are identical before proceeding await table.removeIntersection("geomA", "geomB", "geomA_minus_geomB"); await table.logTable(); await sdb.done(); ```
